note: Subjective quality change; routing measurements are separate. Closed-world ownership: only lateral-engineering on positives and no skill on target-only negatives. No external composition is declared.

should_trigger.prompt: Don't give me the usual architecture for our agent fleet. Find non-obvious alternatives.
Our trace-annotation pipeline for LLM evals is slow because every trace goes through a human review queue. How else could this be done?
I want ideas, not best practices, for reducing LLM inference costs.
Reframe this system design: our event ingestion service keeps needing more coordination.
Find out-of-the-box approaches to developer tooling for debugging ephemeral containers.
We are stuck scaling our data pipeline; the obvious fix doubles the budget. What assumptions can we break?
Our infrastructure is over-engineered and expensive. Suggest creative ways to make whole pieces unnecessary.
Give me lateral approaches to reliability when individual agents frequently fail.
How else could a fixed 4B model make unfamiliar puzzle games reliably? Challenge the harness design.
Can we solve this performance problem through a different unit of work? I want unconventional ideas.

should_not.prompt: Give me the safe, production-proven architecture for retrying payments. No creative alternatives.
We have an active outage. Give me the safest immediate mitigation for HTTP 503 errors.
Explain KV caching in a transformer.
Implement exponential backoff in the existing retry helper.
Our pipeline is slow. Explain how to profile it using standard tools.
Brainstorm creative names for my bakery.
Write a one-shot implementation plan for an already approved data export design.
Critique the evidence behind this latency claim; do not propose alternative architectures.
Interview me about requirements for our new feature.
Create and maintain a living feature dossier for team invitations.
